name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause 2 uses a hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box), which only requires that holding_box occurs sometime (before, with, or after) when the exit is reached. The task says the agent must be carrying the box at the moment it reaches the exit, i.e., holding_box must hold on the same step as at_exit. The correct template is a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent rule that obliges holding_box on the exit step). Replace the RespondedExistence clause with a hard Response clause and regenerate the machine.

texts: Each time the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the very next step.
